Inspired by the Damnation album — where prog excellence replaced brutality with devastating emotional depth — this gothic pullover embodies autumn itself. The dark art design reflects the aching, introspective spirit that made Opeth legends beyond the metal world. Crafted from premium heavyweight fabric, this hoodie delivers warmth and durability through every cold season. The print quality preserves every detail through countless washes, keeping the art as vivid as the music it represents. Whether you're layering for a show or settling into a vinyl evening at home, this pullover fits the mood perfectly. Unisex sizing makes it an ideal heavy metal gift for any Opeth fan who understands that sometimes the heaviest music carries no distortion at all. From the Deathlipse underground — alt fashion for the emotionally fluent metalhead. Not for everyone — for those who find beauty in the somber.
